market_definition: The graphite-enhanced EPS foam market comprises expanded polystyrene foams containing graphite or carbon particles that reflect infrared radiation and cut thermal conductivity. It measures sales of grey EPS boards and panels. BY PRODUCT FORM: Boards, ETICS / Facade Panels, Moulded Shapes. BY THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY: ≤ 0.031 W/mK, 0.032–0.034 W/mK, ≥ 0.035 W/mK. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Building Facades & ETICS, Roofing & Floor Insulation, Prefab Panels, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Standard white EPS; XPS; PIR and PUR boards. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
